scope: Read-only impact audit of recent official announcements, live dashboard inputs and actual served public reports

findings.finding: Current classifications capture non-credit strategies, including USDT termBasis trading. Broader announced mandate, new-strategy risk channels and aggregate launch-cap denominator are not explained in the reviewed report narrative.
findings.impact: Backing, Dependencies, Liquidity and issuer discretion; announcement is not proof of live securities or receivables positions.
findings.action: Reconcile exact allocations, counterparties, leverage/margin, maturity and liquidity terms with producer; document per-pool monitoring. 5% cap is per new strategy of overall Maple deposits, not per-pool or all non-credit aggregate. No breach is inferred.
findings.score: Explicit reassessment required; no mechanical revision from announcement

findings.finding: Both public reports already disclose replacement CCIP pools and incomplete reconciliation. Contract authority inputs retain September 6 observations.
findings.action: Refresh chain/asset-specific token-pool addresses, migration status, minter/burner permissions, owners/timelocks/rate limits and canonical collateral liabilities. Keep native off-Ethereum primary redemption unverified.
findings.score: Do not award upgrade/faster-bridge benefit without new evidence; contract/dependency review

findings.finding: Reports already mention IRACE without claiming pool exposure. Zodia arrangement is not mapped to individual loans.
findings.action: Confirm actual per-loan custody and enforceability before assigning risk/mitigation credit. Do not label all collateral Zodia-held or pool reserves bank-held.
findings.score: No supported change from partnership announcements alone

findings.finding: Report financial updates are dated October 30; October 31 backing and supplemental redemption observations are newer. Reports still say queued monetary amount unavailable. USDC non-credit principal is now approximately $20M versus historical $36.15M, while USDT termBasis is $7.6M versus historical $4.2M.
findings.action: Add a separately dated financial update with current cash, queue size, coverage, strategy changes and clock-specific provenance. Preserve historical statistics and old snapshot labels. Do not infer losses or redemption speed from these differences.
findings.score: Liquidity review uses persistence and processing evidence, not a single spot queue ratio

findings.finding: Recent reviewed Maple forum items concern token buybacks/conversion. govAnalyst already tracks Maple and distinguishes proposal governance from pool administration.
findings.action: Use govAnalyst as governance producer; no separate BM governance/news ingestion or Section 6 redesign.
findings.score: No supported depositor score change from reviewed token-governance topics
